transcript: Millions of people on Twitter are talking about this guy who went from getting fired with no job to landing one of the best AI roles in the world, not by applying more, but by building a free AI that checked 740 jobs and only picked the ones worth his time. Most people send 50 applications on LinkedIn, hear nothing back. This guy stopped doing that completely. He built a free tool called Career-ops. You paste a job link, it reads the job posting, checks it against your resume, tells you if the job is worth applying to. If it scores above 4 out of 5, it updates your resume for that specific job, finds out what salary you should ask for, and even prepares your interview answers, all automatically. 8,200 people have already grabbed it, completely free. But the best part? You don't need to be technical to use this. I've put together a simple step-by-step guide. Anyone can set this up today. Comment CAREER and I'll DM you the free link so you can run your first job search.
